audience: bookkeeping and tax firms that manage clients, contacts and projects in Financial Cents

useCases.title: Find projects that are open and due this week
useCases.text: List client projects with their due dates, billing rates and closed status. Search for a project, then open its client to see the details.

useCases.title: Find a client and its contact details
useCases.text: List clients with a search on the name. Then list the contacts of one client with their email, phone and address.

useCases.title: Find a person across all clients
useCases.text: Search contacts across all clients by name or email. Open one contact for its full details.

useCases.title: Open the links and files of a client or project
useCases.text: List the labelled links and files attached to one client or to one project.

useCases.title: Add a new client with a first contact
useCases.text: Create a client. You can add a first contact with its name, email, address and notes in the same call.

useCases.title: Start a project from a template
useCases.text: List the project templates and the team members. Create a project from one template with its title, client and reviewer.
